Exercise Plan:
1. Strength Training (4x/week):
   - Day 1: Lower Body
     * Squats: 4 sets x 8-12 reps (2 min rest)
     * Romanian Deadlifts: 3 sets x 10-12 reps (90 sec rest)
     * Bulgarian Split Squats: 3 sets x 10 reps each leg
   - Day 2: Upper Body
     * Bench Press: 4 sets x 8-12 reps (2 min rest)
     * Pull-ups: 3 sets x 6-10 reps (90 sec rest)
     * Shoulder Press: 3 sets x 10-12 reps
   - Day 3: Full Body
     * Deadlifts: 4 sets x 6-8 reps (2.5 min rest)
     * Push-ups: 3 sets x 12-15 reps
     * Core Circuit
   - Day 4: Accessory Work
     * Bicep Curls: 3 sets x 12 reps
     * Tricep Extensions: 3 sets x 12 reps
     * Calf Raises: 4 sets x 15 reps
Exercise Progression:
Progression Rules:
1. Increase weight when you can complete all reps with good form
2. Add 2.5kg to upper body, 5kg to lower body
3. Track all workouts in a log
4. Aim for 1-2 more reps each week
5. Deload every 4-6 weeks
